mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, experiment_uuid, case_uuid, case_external_id, position, session_external_id, status, error_message, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_experiment_items ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, experiment_uuid, case_uuid, case_external_id, position, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.ExperimentUUID}, #{params.CaseUUID}, #{params.CaseExternalID}, #{params.Position}, #{params.Status}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT item.uuid, item.external_id, item.organization_uuid, item.workspace_uuid, item.experiment_uuid, item.case_uuid, item.case_external_id, item.position, item.session_external_id, item.status, item.error_message, item.created_at, item.updated_at, experiment.external_id AS experiment_external_id FROM evaluation_experiment_items AS item JOIN evaluation_experiments AS experiment ON experiment.uuid = item.experiment_uuid AND experiment.organization_uuid = item.organization_uuid AND experiment.workspace_uuid = item.workspace_uuid WHERE item.organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND item.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND item.session_external_id = #{sessionExternalID} AND item.status = 'running' ORDER BY item.position ASC, item.uuid ASC
